in_marathi.name: Bhagram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong as a mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhag', meaning to share or to possess. Bhagram is a name that evokes strength, stability, and power. It is believed to be the name of a deity associated with mountains, and is often given to boys in Hindu families as a symbol of courage and resilience.
